item.title: US Rock Climber Alex Honnold Reaches Top of Taipei 101 Skyscraper Without Ropes
item.description: Taipei. American rock climber Alex Honnold ascended the Taipei 101 skyscraper on Sunday without any ropes or protective equipment. Cheers erupted from a street-level crowd as he reached the top of the spire of the 508-meter (1,667-foot) tower about 90 minutes after he started. item.title: BNI Congratulates Alwi Farhan for 2026 Indonesia Masters Win
item.description: Jakarta. State-owned bank BNI congratulated Alwi Farhan for winning the men's singles title at the 2026 Indonesia Masters over the weekend. BNI Corporate Secretary Okki Rushartomo said that his victory reflected how the athlete development process by the Indonesian Badminton Association (PBSI) was a success. item.title: Indonesia to Set Tin Reference Price to Stabilize Market
item.description: Pangkalpinang. Indonesia will soon announce a minimum reference price for tin as part of efforts to stabilize the market and shield local miners from global price volatility, Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia said on Sunday. item.title: Rescuers Recover More Bodies from West Java Landslide, With 72 Still Missing
item.description: Bandung. Improved weather on Sunday helped rescuers recover more bodies as they dug through mud and debris in search of scores of missing in a landslide that killed more than two dozen villagers in West Bandung, West Java. The predawn landslide on the slopes of Mount Burangrang on Saturday buried some 34 houses in Pasir Langu village. item.title: Pegadaian Shares Tips on How to Avoid Recruitment Fraud
item.description: Jakarta. State-owned pawnbroker Pegadaian recently shared some tips on how to avoid recruitment fraud as such crime becomes more rampant day by day. item.title: Dompet Dhuafa Launches Emergency Response in Jakarta Flooding
item.description: Jakarta. Muslim philantropic organization Dompet Dhuafa recently launched an emergency response to the floods affecting the Duri Kosambi and Rawa Buaya sub-districts in West Jakarta. The Dompet Dhuafa Disaster Management Center (DMC) team helped evacuate residents and also distributed ready-to-eat meals. item.title: JCI Starts Week in Green, Tracking Global and Fed Cues
item.description: Jakarta. Indonesia’s benchmark Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) opened higher on Monday, gaining 16.71 points, or 0.19%, to 8,867 in early trade, with the index moving in the 8,959–8,980 range. RTI data showed 1.37 billion shares had changed hands in the opening minutes, with turnover reaching Rp 1.13 trillion ($67.42 million) across 145,273 transactions. item.title: Antam Gold Hits Fresh Record as Global Rally Nears $5,000 an Ounce
item.description: Jakarta. Antam’s gold bar prices resumed their relentless climb on Monday, setting another all-time high as global demand for safe-haven assets stayed strong amid lingering macroeconomic and geopolitical risks. Data from Logam Mulia showed Antam gold prices jumped Rp 30,000 to Rp 2,917,000 ($173.87) per gram on Monday, extending a rally that has accelerated since late last week.
